truth_boundary: Only verified regressions tied to source tests belong here. These entries guide checks; they do not rewrite code or become autobiographical memory.

lessons.expected_behavior: Route a request to recover source conversations to self-memory recall, not package/runtime status.
lessons.observed_failure: Conversation archive was misread as a ZIP/package archive and a package status answer was returned.
lessons.root_cause: Over-broad archive/status lexical patterns lacked conversational-source context.
lessons.repair_rule: Prefer conversation-archive evidence over package archive markers unless an explicit package/ZIP/manifest object is present.

lessons.expected_behavior: Continue the active structured task when the user explicitly approves and commands execution.
lessons.observed_failure: The command was classified as a generic contextual continuation and fell through to fallback.
lessons.root_cause: A bare connective marker dominated classification while the router had no safe contextual-continuation mapping and no structured task state.
lessons.repair_rule: Resolve active task/referent before loose ellipsis classification; unresolved continuation must use ordinary dialogue, not an unsafe fallback action.
